dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed-loop and semi-closed 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with thin, low-intensity perimeters transitioning to lighter grey interiors; prominent across the mid-dorsal surface with non-uniform boundary thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid low-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients, primarily located in the interstitial regions between the larger annular structures and along the lower lateral margins.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle; a secondary constellation of four smaller blobs on the anterior-lateral flank forms an irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: A yellow elliptical identification tag is attached to the hind flipper, displaying the high-contrast black numeric characters '063'.
